struck: If there is a will, it must be filed with the court within 30 days of the death.
use: Whoever has the original will must deliver it to the probate court within 30 days of learning of the death.

struck: The same quick route is open at any value when the personal representative is the only heir, or the only person named in the will.
use: The same quick route is open at any value when the personal representative is the only heir, or the only person the will leaves property to.

struck: A small estate is one worth $25,000 or less.
use: South Carolina has a faster route when the estate is worth $45,000 or less after liens.
